Signalsmith Stretch vendored source
=================================
Official repository: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch
Pinned tag: 1.1.0
Pinned commit: 44c8f865af9da8c29cc4a70a2d5a3ec83639c711
License: MIT, retained in signalsmith-stretch/LICENSE.txt and dsp/LICENSE.txt.
Matches the Signalsmith version attributed by installed Qt Multimedia 6.12.
No downloaded executable is used. MSVC builds the header source locally.
The repository checkout metadata is not a runtime dependency; package sources,
licenses and this provenance file when redistributing the native tempo DLL.
